verdict.rationale: Paystack is a payments platform with public developer docs, so publishing llms.txt or agent-oriented docs is a fair question for it and the axis applies. The probe found that https://paystack.com/llms.txt returns HTTP 404. None of the documentation excerpts mention agent-oriented or LLM-readable docs; standard human-oriented API docs with cURL examples are adjacent and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
